description: This Java source file defines the class EntitySyncServices which provides services for synchronizing entity data across systems, including methods for running synchronization, offline exports/imports, and cleaning up synchronization metadata.

classes.name: EntitySyncServices
classes.description: Service class providing static methods to handle entity synchronization tasks such as running sync processes, offline data export/import, and cleanup operations.

methods.name: runEntitySync
methods.description: Executes an entity synchronization process, including push operations, managing splits, and error handling.

methods.name: storeEntitySyncData
methods.description: Stores incoming entity synchronization data by creating, updating, or removing entities as specified.

methods.name: runPullEntitySync
methods.description: Performs a pull from remote systems, retrieving sync data and storing it locally, handling multiple batches.

methods.name: pullAndReportEntitySyncData
methods.description: Handles remote push of sync result data and retrieves subsequent batch data for synchronization.

methods.name: runOfflineEntitySync
methods.description: Exports entity sync data to an XML file for offline processing or transfer.

methods.name: loadOfflineSyncData
methods.description: Loads and imports sync data from an offline XML file into the system.

methods.name: updateOfflineEntitySync
methods.description: Placeholder method intended for future implementation to update offline sync configurations.

methods.name: cleanSyncRemoveInfo
methods.description: Removes outdated synchronization removal info based on timestamp thresholds.
